title: Signs of the End of Days
body:
As-salaamu `alaykum. (Mawlana Shaykh stands)
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Kareem Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Subhaan Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Sultan Allah
Alfu salaat, alfu salaam `alaa Sayyidi 'l-Awwaleen wa ’l-`Akhireen, Sayyidina Muhammadan wa aalihi wa
saahbihi wa sallim wa man tabi`ahum ila Yawm ad-Deen. (Mawlana Shaykh sits) A`oodhu billahi min ashShaytani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. Yaa Rabbee!
We must speak in English because so many people are coming from far distances, from beyond the oceans,
from America, Australia, Singapore, Russia, England, France, Germany, Italy, Spain, and all groups of people
living on Earth are sending someone on their behalf to hear, listen, understand, and give a report to their
people. I am not calling anyone. I am only a weak servant, but a heavenly command from holy people is
making me be here today to address this handful of people, and these instruments (cameras, Internet) are
taking this address from east to west, from north to south.

I am only a weak servant like everyone else. Titles are given to people by people, but the real title that is an
honored title comes from Heavens. Heavens is not looking at our clothes, but people living on Earth are
looking to their dressings. They dress in so many fashions and are saying, "That is an honorable dressing."
No, from Man to Man there can't be an honorable dressing. That is something that tailors or fashion
designers make to cheat people, to run after that dressing, to gain much more materialism. The honor of real
dresses comes from Heavens, but people are saying to those who wear it, "What is this?" People are kicking
them from their assemblies and meetings, saying, "Ohhhh, go away!" You don't know that one is dressed in a
heavenly dressing. But people now from east to west, north to south, and even in Muslim countries think that
honor is granted to Man from Man, or from their clothes, or by what they are putting on their heads, or
where they are sitting. They think if they sit on a chair, the chair is giving them honor. What is that? They are
asking honor from a chair and not asking for honor from the Lord of Heavens. What is that foolishness?
What are they learning? That is a shaytanic teaching. Therefore, there is never going to be (real honor), it is
only for one, even His Majesty, the King and Her Majesty, the Queen are not sitting on one throne, they are
making one here and one there.
O People! Try to learn about your creation. If you do not know yourself, what is the benefit of knowing so
many things? You may fill hundreds or thousands of libraries with books, but who reads those books can't
understand himself. You must try to know yourself. Yes, now everywhere they have so many universities for
people. Before yesterday a director came to me and he said, "I am the director of a university and it has so
many branches."
I said, "Say to me, what is the difference between your faculties."
He said, "We offer doctorates in medicine, law, engineering and chemistry."
I said to him, "And there is nothing teaching you about yourself." He was astonished. "You have ten, fifteen or
twenty faculties teaching people, but I am sorry to say you are leaving the most important subject and not
taking any care. You are teaching so many things."
And he was astonished and asked, "What is that?"
I said, "Are you teaching your students about themselves? Bring a definition for their being. You are not
teaching them about themselves or to ask, 'Who are you?' or, 'Who am I?' And you are looking in the mirror
and asking, 'Who is that one?' If you are saying, 'That is your self,' that means I am in such a way. Is there
anything else? Nothing else! I am asking, 'Who am I?' Do you think I am that one? It is just an appearance in

a mirror, not giving my real identity."
That is the biggest blame and mistake of all countries. They left the most important knowledge that they must
know, "Who am I?" You may say, "I am a lawyer, an educator, an engineer," but who are you and what is your
real identity? All troubles from east to west, from north to south, and on all continents are from people
fighting each other, and for what? They do not know and ask, "Why am I killing? Why am I making such
terrible weapons?" For what? Is that your real mission in life, to kill each other, to destroy each other, to burn
everything? Is that Man's real mission?
How are they saying, "We reached the top of civilization"? Is the top of civilization to burn everything, to kill
everything, to make continents empty and to make cities in ruins? Is that their mission on Earth? Ptuu (spit)
on them, and on those who are teaching them spit 70 times, because they are not teaching heavenly
teachings! They are not teaching about the beginning of life on this Earth, nor about the special, chosen
people who are calling them to something, the 124,000 people that came with heavenly messages. They are
never teaching this because their knowledge is based on shaytanic teachings. Blame to them! And that is is
the final point for them; Shaytan is preparing to kill everyone and destroy everything on Earth, to make it like
the moon, an empty planet. You can't look at it. They are looking at the moon, seeing mountains and big
places, deep valleys, saying, "We found some oceans, and we understood maybe there were also living plants,
animals and such creations, but now we are see nothing."
Shaytan is now asking to make this world as the moon, not no one to live on it, no more life for plants,
animals or Mankind, because shaytanic teachings, the biggest cursing on Earth, are teaching, "You must kill,
burn, and destroy." But the one who kills and the one who is killed are human beings, and there is enough
room for all nations, so why are you killing?
Now the biggest super powers on Earth are trying to fight. When they fight, there will be no more life on
Earth. We have been informed of this event through prophecy, through heavenly messages. It was just
reported and taught to people that everything that has a beginning must have an end, even if we were not
witnesses at the beginning. There was a beginning and for every beginning there must be an end. The Last
Prophet, the Seal of Messengers (s), (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) informed us that when time is over,
when the Last Day is near and the Day of Judgment approaches, there will be so many very cursed Signs. One

of the Signs that will be at the end of the period of Mankind on this planet is a huge war. Life will not finish
and the Judgment Day will not come except after a big war. Fi'atayn `azheematayn, the world is going to be
in two camps, one camp against the other. When they assemble in two parties, there will be the biggest war,
as they are saying, "Armageddon." From five billion people, four billion will die.
O People! That is approaching and it needs only one match. From the Far East, now they are trying to make
that fire. If that fire appears, from every five people, four are going to be taken away and only one will remain.
O People! Come and listen, and say, "O our Lord, forgive us! O our Lord, grant us! O our Lord, send Shaytan
and its agents away from our homelands!" It is now approaching. Two camps just happened now in the east
and west; it needs only one match and boom (it will implode)! May Allah forgive us.
O People! Come and learn who you are and for which purpose you have been created on this planet that you
have lived on for thousands of years. Come and teach. They are not teaching, and if they are not teaching,
heavenly punishment will come, and only one match is making it like it never existed.
O People! Try to learn about yourselves. Who are you, and Who brought you from Unknown Worlds to this
planet? Learn, and the Lord of Heavens, your Creator, will protect you. If not, you may look (at what will
happen). I don't know. Today is Muharram, and Muharram is full of big events. People are making so many
plans for this year and next year, but I don't think they will reach their purposes. In this very terrible month
heavenly cursing is coming, because they are following Shaytan and Shaytan is the Cursed One. If they follow
the Cursed One they will be taken away. May Allah forgive us.
O People! O People! O People! O Youngsters! Try to know about yourselves and Who brought you from
unknown climates to this planet. May Allah forgive us.
O People! Astaghfirullah, astaghfirullah, astaghfirullah. I don't know what is going to happen up to next
Jumu`ah. Terrible events are approaching. Keep to yourselves and keep your servanthood for your Creator.
Give your most high respect and obediency; if not, you will be taken away. Yaa Rabbee! Anta Rabbuna! Anta
Hasbuna! Anta Waliyyuna! Anta Mawlana! Bi jaahi nabiyyika al-kareem, Sayyidi 'l-awwaleen wa ’l-akhireen,
bi hurmati 'l-Fatihah.

(Baya`)
